chat.message.description: Runs when someone writes in the chat of any connected platform, or just one. Use it for things that should work everywhere.

fields.platform: Pick one platform, or "All" to react to chat from all of them.
fields.contains: Only run when the message has this text in it, like "hello". Capital letters do not matter. Leave empty to run for every message.

variables.platform: Where it was written, like Twitch or Kick
variables.user: Name of the person who wrote
variables.isModerator: True if they are a moderator
variables.isVip: True if they are a VIP
variables.isSubscriber: True if they are a subscriber

chat.activity.description: Runs when something happens on any platform, like a follow, a subscription, a tip or a raid. One trigger for the same event everywhere.

fields.platform: Pick one platform, or "All" to react to events from all of them.
fields.kind: The kind of event to react to, like Follow, Tip or Raid. "Any" runs for every kind. "Other" is anything that fits no kind.

variables.kind: What kind of event it was
variables.title: A short line about it, like "Alice followed"
variables.detail: More information, if there is any
variables.amount: The amount, like $5.00, if money or points were involved

chat.emoteAdded.description: Runs when a new emote appears in a 7TV, BTTV or FFZ emote set (add-ons that give chat extra emotes). Cuebot rechecks every so often.

fields.provider: Pick the emote add-on to watch: 7TV, BTTV or FFZ. "Any" watches all of them.

variables.platform: Which platform's set it is in
variables.imageUrl: Web link to the emote picture

chat.emoteRemoved.description: Runs when an emote disappears from a 7TV, BTTV or FFZ emote set (add-ons that give chat extra emotes). Cuebot rechecks every so often.

fields.provider: Pick the emote add-on to watch: 7TV, BTTV or FFZ. "Any" watches all of them.

variables.platform: Which platform's set it was in

chat.emotesChanged.description: Runs once after a check finds changes in an emote set, however many emotes changed. Use it for a single summary instead of one run per emote.

fields.provider: Pick the emote add-on to watch: 7TV, BTTV or FFZ. "Any" watches all of them.

variables.added: Names of the new emotes, separated by commas
variables.removed: Names of the removed emotes, separated by commas

chat.send.description: Writes a chat message on one platform, or on every connected platform at once. Good for announcements.

fields.platform: Pick where to write, or "All" for every connected platform. Platforms that cannot send are skipped.
fields.message: What to write, like "Thanks for the follow, %user%!".
fields.sameAsTrigger: Tick to write on the platform the action came from instead of the one picked above. It works when the action started from a chat trigger.

variables.sentTo: The platforms that got the message, separated by commas

chat.refreshEmotes.description: Downloads the 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emote lists again, so Cuebot knows about new emotes.

fields.force: Tick to always download again. Untick to reuse the saved lists when they are still fresh.

variables.emoteCount: How many emotes Cuebot knows now

discord.basicWebhook.description: Posts a message in a Discord channel through a webhook (a private address Discord gives you for that channel).

fields.name: A name for you to remember this webhook by. It is not sent to Discord.
fields.webhookUrl: The webhook link. Copy it in Discord: Server Settings, Integrations, Webhooks, then Copy Webhook URL. Keep it private.
fields.content: The message text. Up to 2000 letters. To ping someone use <@USER_ID>, for a role use <@&ROLE_ID>.
fields.username: The name shown as the sender. Empty uses the webhook's own name.
fields.avatarUrl: Web link to a picture for the sender. Empty uses the webhook's own picture.
fields.textToSpeech: Tick to let Discord read the message out loud to people watching that channel.

variables.messageId: ID of the Discord message that was posted

pronouns.addForUser.description: Looks up a Twitch user's pronouns (from alejo.io) and saves them as variables, so you can say "he/him" correctly in chat.

fields.user: The Twitch login name to look up. The default is the person who started this action.
fields.prefix: A word put in front of the variable names. With "target" you get %targetPronoun%. Empty gives %pronoun%.

variables.hasPronouns: True if the person has set pronouns
variables.pronounAltSubject: The first word of a second set, if they have one
variables.pronounAltObject: The second word of a second set, if they have one
